name: Ormak Grimshot
summary: In Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor, Ormak Grimshot trains hunters for life in the wild. Beside his wolf, Grimfang, he teaches Horde hunters to track, shoot, and tame beasts.

sections.title: Master of the Hunt
sections.body: Ormak Grimshot trains Horde trackers and marksmen in the Hunter's Hall. With his wolf, Grimfang, at his side, he teaches the skills needed to survive Kalimdor's wilderness. Orc and troll hunters who have completed their trials in Durotar learn from him how to tame and command wild beasts, and to form a lasting bond with an animal companion.

faq.answer: Ormak Grimshot trains Horde hunters in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor. He teaches ranged combat and how to master beasts.

faq.q: Where can I find Ormak Grimshot?
faq.answer: Ormak is inside the Hunter's Hall in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor. His wolf, Grimfang, is near him.

faq.q: Who is the wolf beside him?
faq.answer: The wolf beside Ormak is Grimfang, his loyal companion. Their bond shows how a hunter and an animal companion work together.

faq.q: What role does he play for new hunters?
faq.answer: Ormak teaches novice orc and troll hunters to train, feed, and manage beasts they have tamed after their basic trials in Durotar.

angles.text: As a Horde hunter, you can learn from Ormak how to tame and care for a loyal animal companion.
As an orc, you can look to Ormak's partnership with Grimfang as an example of working alongside wolves and native predators to defend Durotar.
